items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: The A bands in New York for a long time was Richard Tee, Steve Gadd on drums, Ralph McDonald percussion, I mean Hugh McCracken on guitar, Eric Gale on guitar.

ctx.x: But in L.A. that was different then.

Well the New York, since in New York there was a clique of guys, maybe ten guys. They worked all the time. Be it two bass players or two drummers or whatever. In other words they were like the on-call guys. They worked all the time. And then there were a lot of other guys that worked. Like at that point it was up to the producer or arranger wanting a special member or something. But there was always an A band, I’ll put it that way. The A bands in New York for a long time was Richard Tee, Steve Gadd on drums,…
Well a little trade secret for some reason I was thinking did you have a special technique to record acoustic basses, which always seems to be one of the harder things to do in the recording world?
